# Differential Expression Analysis -- FIGURES

#===================================================================
# THIS SCRIPT ONLY GENERATES FIGURES -- reads DE_analysis_results.rds
# (from 04_DE_analysis_COMPUTE_cleaned.Rmd) and the frozen
# DE_SPE_annotaion.csv; never recomputes the DE tests or spatial group
# definitions. Safe to re-run as often as needed.
#
# VERSION NOTE (revised): earlier versions of this cleanup incorrectly
# dropped several plot variants just because their ggsave() calls were
# commented out in one particular source file -- but those variants
# were still named, real figures elsewhere (e.g. Figure 1G, Figure 2A's
# highlighted volcano variants). Policy going forward: ALL graph
# variants are kept unless explicitly confirmed as disposable drafts,
# never silently dropped based on assuming "later = final".
#
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT PRODUCES
# --------------------------
# Figures (output/04_DE_analysis/figures/):
#   - Figure1F_spatial_four_categories_one_patient.pdf
#       Figure 1F. The four spatial categories, one representative
#       patient.
#   - Figure1G_category_spots_per_patient.pdf
#       Figure 1G. Spot counts per category, with nerve counts overlaid
#       for the nerve-containing groups.
#   - Figure1H_HE_overlay_full_section.pdf
#       Figure 1H. The four categories on the H&E image of a
#       representative diseased section.
#   - Figure1H_zoom_panels.pdf / Figure1H_zoom_panels_cairo.pdf
#     Figure1H_zoom1.png / Figure1H_zoom2.png / Figure1H_zoom3.png
#       Figure 1H. The zoomed regions of the same section, combined and
#       as individual panels. The two combined files are the same plot
#       written with different devices.
#   - Figure2A_volcano_invaded_vs_noninvaded.pdf
#       Figure 2A. Invaded versus non-invaded nerve volcano, malignant
#       and adipocyte programmes highlighted.
#   - Figure3A_invaded_nerve_prioritization.pdf
#       Figure 3A. Invaded-vs-non-invaded log fold change against the
#       tumour-distal control contrast, invaded-nerve-specific genes
#       highlighted.
#   - Figure3C_tumor_vs_nerve_correlation.pdf
#       Figure 3C. Spearman correlation of the invaded-nerve-specific
#       genes with the tumour and nerve NMF programmes.
#   - FigureS17A_volcano_tumorproximal_vs_tumordistal.pdf
#       Figure S17A. Tumour-proximal versus tumour-distal volcano.
#   - FigureS17B_tumor_proximity_two_contrast.pdf
#       Figure S17B. Tumour-proximity prioritization against the
#       nerve-versus-tumour-distal control contrast.
#   - Figure6G_heatmap_tumor_proximity_genes.pdf
#       Figure 6G. Grouped heatmap of the top 17 tumour-proximity genes.
#   - exploratory_spatial_four_categories_all_samples.pdf
#     exploratory_composition_by_location.pdf
#     exploratory_volcano_invaded_vs_noninvaded_basic.pdf
#     exploratory_volcano_invaded_vs_noninvaded_programs.pdf
#       Kept for reference. NOT in the manuscript.
#
# Anything named "exploratory_" is not in the manuscript.
#
# Tables (output/04_DE_analysis/tables/):
#   - DE_TumorProximal_vs_TumorDistal_full.csv
#       Every tested gene, limma output as is.
#   - DE_TumorProximal_vs_TumorDistal_with_control_contrast.csv
#       The same genes with the control contrast alongside and the
#       two-step selection flag, so the filtering can be reproduced.
#===================================================================

```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(ggspavis)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=14))

# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")
PROCESSED_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "processed")

ANALYSIS_NAME <- "04_DE_analysis"
FIGURES_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

c25 <- c(
  "dodgerblue2", "#E31A1C", "green4", "#6A3D9A", "#FF7F00",
  "black", "gold1", "skyblue2", "#FB9A99", "palegreen2",
  "#CAB2D6", "#FDBF6F", "gray70", "khaki2",
  "maroon", "orchid1", "deeppink1", "blue1", "steelblue4",
  "darkturquoise", "green1", "yellow4", "yellow3",
  "darkorange4", "brown"
)

# ---- Frozen inputs: never recomputed here ------------------------------
spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "DE_SPE_annotaion.csv")))
colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode

DE <- readRDS(file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "DE_analysis_results.rds"))
# convenience unpack
topSen <- DE$topSen
compNerve <- DE$compNerve; defint_invaded <- DE$defint_invaded
corr_invaded_genes_df <- DE$corr_invaded_genes_df
topRec <- DE$topRec
compRec <- DE$compRec; defint_tumorprox <- DE$defint_tumorprox
sb <- DE$sb; sub <- DE$sub

# ---- Export full DE tables (before the two-step filtering) -------------------
TABLES_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "tables")
dir.create(TABLES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1) Tumour proximal vs tumour distal: every tested gene, limma output as is
tp_full <- topRec[, c("Gene", "logFC", "AveExpr", "t", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val", "B")]
names(tp_full) <- c("Gene", "log2FC_TumorProximal_vs_TumorDistal", "AveExpr", "t",
                    "P.Value", "FDR", "B")
tp_full <- tp_full[order(tp_full$P.Value), ]
write.csv(tp_full, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "DE_TumorProximal_vs_TumorDistal_full.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 2) Same genes with the control contrast (Nerve vs tumour distal) next to it and
#    the two-step selection flag, so the filtering can be reproduced or changed later
#    (compRec's 'InvadedNerve.*' columns are actually TumorProximal vs TumorDistal;
#     'Rec.*' columns are Nerve vs TumorDistal - renamed here to say so)
tp_two <- data.frame(
  Gene = compRec$InvadedNerve.Gene,
  log2FC_TumorProximal_vs_TumorDistal = compRec$InvadedNerve.logFC,
  FDR_TumorProximal_vs_TumorDistal    = compRec$InvadedNerve.adj.P.Val,
  log2FC_Nerve_vs_TumorDistal         = compRec$Rec.logFC,
  FDR_Nerve_vs_TumorDistal            = compRec$Rec.adj.P.Val,
  Significance                        = compRec$Significance,
  Selected_tumour_proximity_specific  = defint_tumorprox)
write.csv(tp_two, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "DE_TumorProximal_vs_TumorDistal_with_control_contrast.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("Exported", nrow(tp_full), "genes;", sum(tp_full$FDR < 0.1), "with FDR < 0.1;",
    sum(defint_tumorprox), "selected by the two-step filter\n")

# ---- Scale bar setup ------------------------------------------------------
# Single, consistent calibration source, used for every spatial plot in
# this script -- reused directly from um_per_pixel_CALIBRATED.rds.
um_per_pixel <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "um_per_pixel_CALIBRATED.rds"))
cat("Loaded calibrated um_per_pixel:", round(um_per_pixel, 6), "\n")

add_scale_bar_fullres <- function(p, bar_um = 500, x_frac = 0.05, y_frac = 0.05, label_size = 3) {
  built <- ggplot_build(p)
  xr <- built$layout$panel_scales_x[[1]]$range$range
  yr <- built$layout$panel_scales_y[[1]]$range$range
  bar_len_px <- bar_um / um_per_pixel
  x0 <- xr[1] + x_frac * diff(xr); x1 <- x0 + bar_len_px
  y0 <- yr[1] + y_frac * diff(yr)
  p + annotate("segment", x = x0, xend = x1, y = y0, yend = y0, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = (x0 + x1) / 2, y = y0 + 0.03 * diff(yr), label = paste0(bar_um, " \u00b5m"),
             size = label_size, vjust = 0)
}
```

# Spatial overview, all samples -- exploratory, not in the manuscript
```{r}
p1 <- ggcells(spe, aes(x = array_col, y = -array_row)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, aes(color = Area)) +
  facet_grid(
    context ~ patient,
    labeller = labeller(
      context = c("Adjacent" = "Adjacent", "Diseased" = "Diseased"),
      patient  = c("Patient 1" = "Patient 1", "Patient 2" = "Patient 2", "Patient 3" = "Patient 3")
    )
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  # NOTE: array_col/array_row (grid indices) rather than pixel
  # coordinates -- these ARE naturally comparable across samples
  # (Visium's capture area is a fixed grid size), unlike absolute pixel
  # coordinates which differ per slide position. This also sidesteps
  # the free-scale-per-facet problem a physical scale bar would hit
  # here. A light grid every 10 spots is shown instead of a micron
  # scale bar, so distances can be judged directly in spot counts --
  # the natural unit for Visium data, and arguably more informative
  # here than microns for a multi-sample overview like this one.
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(10), minor_breaks = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(10), minor_breaks = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2))) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Type",
    values = c(c25[1], c25[3], "grey90", c25[5], c25[2]),
    labels = c("other"="Other","Nerve"="Non-invaded Nerve","TumorProximal"="Tumor Proximal",
              "InvadedNerve"="Invaded Nerve","TumorDistal"="Tumor Distal")
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.2),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal")
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_spatial_four_categories_all_samples.pdf"), p1, width = 14, height = 10)
p1
```

# Figure 1G -- spot/nerve counts per spatial category
```{r}
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(spe))
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    patient = factor(patient, levels = c("Patient 1","Patient 2","Patient 3")),
    context = factor(context, levels = c("Diseased","Adjacent")),
    group   = Area
  )

spots_counts <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  dplyr::count(group, context, patient, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(measure = "Spots")

nerves_counts <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(NerveID)) %>%
  distinct(group, context, patient, NerveID) %>%
  dplyr::count(group, context, patient, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(measure = "Nerves")

counts_long <- bind_rows(spots_counts, nerves_counts) %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = c("Spots","Nerves"))) %>%
  mutate(context = factor(context, levels = c("Adjacent", "Diseased")))

base_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), axis.title.x = element_blank())

plot_spots_only <- function(counts_long, grp, title = grp) {
  df <- counts_long %>% filter(group == grp, measure == "Spots")
  ggplot(df, aes(x = context, y = n, fill = patient)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    labs(title = title, y = "Spots", fill = "Patient") + base_theme
}

plot_nerve_spots_with_N <- function(counts_long, grp, title = grp) {
  df <- counts_long %>% filter(group == grp) %>%
    select(group, context, patient, measure, n) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
  ggplot(df, aes(x = context, y = Spots, fill = patient)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Nerves > 0, paste0("N=", Nerves), "")),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "black") +
    labs(title = title, y = "Spots", fill = "Patient") + base_theme
}

p_invaded <- plot_nerve_spots_with_N(counts_long, "InvadedNerve", "Invaded nerves")
p_uninv   <- plot_nerve_spots_with_N(counts_long, "Nerve", "Non-invaded nerves")
p_tprox   <- plot_spots_only(counts_long, "TumorProximal", "Nerve-adjacent tumor")
p_tdist   <- plot_spots_only(counts_long, "TumorDistal", "Nerve-remote tumor")

panel_2x2 <- (p_invaded | p_uninv) / (p_tprox | p_tdist) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure1G_category_spots_per_patient.pdf"), panel_2x2, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 600)
panel_2x2
```

# Zoomed histology panels
```{r}
make_zoom_pair <- function(spe_obj, zoom_xlim, zoom_ylim, y_rev = TRUE, spot_size = 2.5) {
   p_img <- plotVisium(spe_obj, x_coord = "pxl_col_in_fullres", y_coord = "pxl_row_in_fullres",
                       image = TRUE, spots = FALSE, y_reverse = y_rev) +
     coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = zoom_xlim, ylim = zoom_ylim, expand = FALSE, clip = "on") +
     theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_blank())
   p_img$layers <- Filter(function(l) !inherits(l$geom, "GeomPoint"), p_img$layers)

   p_spots <- plotVisium(spe_obj, x_coord = "pxl_col_in_fullres", y_coord = "pxl_row_in_fullres",
                         image = TRUE, spots = TRUE, fill = "Area", y_reverse = y_rev) +
     scale_fill_manual(values = c("InvadedNerve"=c25[1],"Nerve"=c25[3],"TumorDistal"=c25[5],"TumorProximal"=c25[2]),
                       labels = c("InvadedNerve"="Invaded Nerve","Nerve"="Non-invaded Nerve",
                                 "TumorDistal"="Tumor Distal","TumorProximal"="Tumor Proximal")) +
     coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = zoom_xlim, ylim = zoom_ylim, expand = FALSE, clip = "on") +
     theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal", plot.title = element_blank())

   is_point_layer <- vapply(p_spots$layers, function(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomPoint"), logical(1))
   if (any(is_point_layer)) for (i in which(is_point_layer)) {
     p_spots$layers[[i]]$aes_params$size <- spot_size
     p_spots$layers[[i]]$aes_params$alpha <- 1
     p_spots$layers[[i]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0
   }
   # Zoom panels already use coord_fixed(ratio=1, xlim=..., ylim=...)
   # above, so a scale bar here is guaranteed physically accurate.
   p_spots <- add_scale_bar_fullres(p_spots, bar_um = 100, x_frac = 0.08, y_frac = 0.06, label_size = 2.5)
   p_img / p_spots
}

spe_p1d <- spe_use[, spe_use$sample_id %in% "54703bl28_highPNI"]
p_pair1 <- make_zoom_pair(spe_p1d, c(1050, 1350), c(650, 950))
p_pair2 <- make_zoom_pair(spe_p1d, c(1450, 1750), c(1050, 1350))
p_pair3 <- make_zoom_pair(spe_p1d, c(350, 650), c(360, 660))

final2 <- (p_pair1 | (p_pair2 + theme(legend.position = "none")) | (p_pair3 + theme(legend.position = "none"))) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal")
final2

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure1H_zoom_panels.pdf"), final2, width = 12, height = 6, units = "in")
library(ragg)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure1H_zoom1.png"), p_pair1, width = 3.2, height = 6.0, units = "in", dpi = 600, device = ragg::agg_png, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure1H_zoom2.png"), p_pair2, width = 3.2, height = 6.0, units = "in", dpi = 600, device = ragg::agg_png, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure1H_zoom3.png"), p_pair3, width = 3.2, height = 6.0, units = "in", dpi = 600, device = ragg::agg_png, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure1H_zoom_panels_cairo.pdf"), final2, device = cairo_pdf, width = 12, height = 6, units = "in")
```

# Composition by location -- exploratory, not in the manuscript
```{r}
color_maping <- c("Acinar"="gold1","B_cells"="maroon","Lymphocytes"="green4","Endocrine"="yellow4",
                  "Myeloid(Macrophages)"="#6A3D9A","Endothelial"="#FF7F00","CAF"="skyblue2",
                  "Adipocytes"="steelblue4","Ductal_normal"="black","Myeloid(C1q_macrophages)"="#CAB2D6",
                  "Nerve"="#FDBF6F","Muscle"="orchid1","Ductal_malignant"="gray70")

cmp <- t(reducedDim(spe,"compk30"))
out_comp <- data.frame()
for (grp in unique(spe$invasion)) {
  meanComp <- rowMeans(cmp[,spe$invasion==grp])
  out_comp <- rbind(out_comp, data.frame("Area"=grp,"Tissue"=names(meanComp),"Value"=unname(meanComp)))
}

out2 <- out_comp |>
  dplyr::filter(Area %in% c("Nerve", "InvadedNerve","Surr_Invaded", "Surr_NonInvaded")) |>
  mutate(location = recode(Area, "Surr_NonInvaded"="Proximal","Surr_Invaded"="Proximal",
                           "InvadedNerve"="Inside","Nerve"="Inside"))
out2$Area <- dplyr::recode(out2$Area, "Nerve"="Non-invaded nerve","InvadedNerve"="Invaded nerve",
                           "Surr_NonInvaded"="Non-invaded nerve","Surr_Invaded"="Invaded nerve")

p_f1i <- ggplot(out2, aes(y = location, x = Value, fill = Tissue)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = NA) +
  scale_x_continuous() + scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  scale_fill_manual("Cell type", values = color_maping) +
  facet_grid(Area ~ ., switch = "y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.y.right = element_text(size = 10), axis.text.y.left = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.ticks.y.left = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), strip.placement = "outside",
        legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 20, 10))
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_composition_by_location.pdf"), p_f1i, width = 8, height = 4)
p_f1i
```

# Invaded vs Non-invaded nerve volcano, basic -- exploratory
```{r}
p4a <- ggplot(topSen, aes(x=logFC, y=-log10(FDR))) +
    geom_point(size=.5,color="grey80") +
    geom_point(data=topSen[topSen$FDR<0.1,], size=1.5)+
    geom_text_repel(data=topSen[1:20,], aes(label=Gene),size=3,max.overlaps=50) +
```

# Invaded vs Non-invaded nerve volcano, programme highlighting -- exploratory
```{r}
topSen$color <- "black"
HEV_program <- c("ACKR1","SELP","CCL2","CCL14","CXCL2")
topSen$color[topSen$Gene %in% HEV_program] <- "dodgerblue2"
Fibro_program <- c("CFD","C3","CXCL12","EFEMP1")
topSen$color[topSen$Gene %in% Fibro_program] <- "green4"
Anti_program <- c("CCL19","CCL21","PTAFR","LILRB2","FCGR2B")
topSen$color[topSen$Gene %in% Anti_program] <- "#E31A1C"

p4b <- ggplot(topSen, aes(x=logFC, y=-log10(FDR))) +
    geom_point(size=.5,color="grey80") +
    geom_point(data=topSen[topSen$FDR<0.1,], size=1.5,color=topSen[topSen$FDR<0.1,]$color)+
    geom_text_repel(data=topSen[1:20,], aes(label=Gene),size=3,max.overlaps=50) +
    geom_text_repel(data=topSen[topSen$Gene %in% c(HEV_program,Fibro_program,Anti_program), ],
                    aes(label=Gene),size=3,max.overlaps=50, color=topSen[topSen$Gene %in% c(HEV_program,Fibro_program,Anti_program), ]$color, force = 20) +
    theme(text=element_text(size=12)) + xlab("logFC") + ylab("-log10(FDR)") +
    labs(caption = "Invaded nerves - Non-invaded nerves") +
    theme_bw()+ theme(panel.border = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(),
                      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, margin = margin(t = 10, b = 5)),
                      plot.margin = margin(b = 40))
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_volcano_invaded_vs_noninvaded_programs.pdf"), p4b, width = 10, height = 12)
```

# Figure 2A -- invaded vs non-invaded nerve volcano, malignant/adipocyte highlighting
```{r}
Malignant <- c("KRT19","KRT7","KRT17","EPCAM","S100P", "CEACAM6")
topSen$color[topSen$Gene %in% Malignant] <- "dodgerblue2"
Adipocytes <- c("PLA2G2A","FABP4","PLTP")
topSen$color[topSen$Gene %in% Adipocytes] <- "green4"

topSen$category <- "Other"
topSen$category[topSen$Gene %in% Malignant] <- "Malignant"
topSen$category[topSen$Gene %in% Adipocytes] <- "Adipocytes"
topSen$category <- factor(topSen$category, levels = c("Other","Malignant","Adipocytes"))

p_cat <- ggplot(topSen, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR))) +
  geom_point(data = subset(topSen, category == "Other"), color = "grey85", size = 0.45) +
  geom_point(data = subset(topSen, category != "Other"), aes(color = category), size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(topSen, category != "Other"), aes(label = Gene, color = category),
                  size = 5, max.overlaps = 50, force = 15, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Malignant"="dodgerblue2","Adipocytes"="green4")) +
  labs(x = "logFC", y = "-log10(FDR)", color = "Category", caption = "Invaded nerves - Non-invaded nerves") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.6),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, margin = margin(t = 10, b = 5)),
        plot.margin = margin(b = 40))
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure2A_volcano_invaded_vs_noninvaded.pdf"), p_cat, width = 10, height = 10)
p_cat
```

```{r}
  geom_text_repel(data = compNerve[control_genes, , drop = FALSE], aes(label = InvadedNerve.Gene),
                  color = "black", size = 2.8, fontface = "italic", segment.size = 0.25, segment.color = "black",
                  box.padding = 0.45, point.padding = 0.3, force_pull = 0, nudge_y = 0.35, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 2) +
```

# Figure 3C -- tumour vs nerve NMF correlation of invaded-nerve-specific genes
```{r}
pal <- c("Nerve"="#D62728","Tumor"="#2CA02C","Both"="dodgerblue4","None"="grey80")

top_nerve <- corr_invaded_genes_df %>% filter(Group == "Nerve") %>% arrange(desc(NerveCor)) %>% slice_head(n = 5)
top_tumor <- corr_invaded_genes_df %>% filter(Group == "Tumor") %>% arrange(desc(TumorCor)) %>% slice_head(n = 5)
top_both <- corr_invaded_genes_df %>% filter(Group == "Both") %>% mutate(BothScore = TumorCor + NerveCor) %>% arrange(desc(BothScore)) %>% slice_head(n = 2)
tolbl_corr <- bind_rows(top_nerve, top_tumor, top_both) %>% distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

a3 <- ggplot(corr_invaded_genes_df, aes(TumorCor, NerveCor)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey85") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey85") +
  geom_point(aes(color = Group), size = 2.4, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text_repel(data = tolbl_corr, aes(label = Gene), color = "black", size = 4, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal) + theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4), axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4), legend.position = "right") +
  labs(x = "Spearman \u03c1 (Tumor NMF vs gene)", y = "Spearman \u03c1 (Nerve NMF vs gene)", color = NULL)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure3C_tumor_vs_nerve_correlation.pdf"), plot = a3, width = 110/25.4, height = 85/25.4)
a3
```
